description: The engine's vendor ports (D-069 item 7, plan v3.1 R1): which adapter serves each port, and the model ladder.

providers.adapter_dir.description: Directory every new adapter module lives in; the vendor check refuses a new adapter elsewhere.

providers.agent_claude_cli.description: The Claude Code CLI the Claude adapter runs (a name on PATH or a path).

providers.agent_claude_model_pattern.description: Model ids and aliases the Claude adapter serves; a ladder rung of provider claude must match it.

providers.agent_default.description: Agent provider adapter a caller gets when it names none; codex and cursor are documented slots without an adapter yet.

providers.ci_local_command.description: Gate command the local runner executes with --pr N, relative to the repository root.

providers.ci_runner.description: CI runner adapter that runs a PR's gate: local runs the gate command in this checkout, on a laptop or a provider cloud session alike. GitHub Actions is never one.
providers.ci_runner.x-source: AGENTS.md (no GitHub Actions or third-party CI); plan v3.1 delta §2 R1

providers.model_escalate_after_failures.description: Real (code-class) failures on one model after which the step moves up the ladder; flakes and env failures do not count.
providers.model_escalate_after_failures.x-source: plan v3.1 delta §4 (escalate one model after two real failures)

providers.model_escalation_step.description: How many rungs one escalation climbs; the top rung stays the top.

default.use: PRs that fix a format or design others build on, and decisive work

providers.model_ladder.description: Model rungs from the least to the most capable. A step's tier picks its rung; escalation moves up this order and never down. model is the provider's model id or alias, stored as data.

providers.storage_adapter.description: Storage adapter behind the storage port: local keeps each key as a file under the caller's directory (the tier-1 result cache today).

providers.vendor_catalog.description: The engine vendor catalog: each vendor's endpoints, CLIs and client modules, its adapters and selectors, and the shrink-only baseline of call sites outside them.

providers.vendor_catalog_schema.description: JSON Schema the vendor catalog is validated against.

providers.vendor_check_excludes.description: Path prefixes of the engine paths (config.literal_check_roots) the vendor check does not scan: test doubles name vendors on purpose, and generated types are the drift stage's. Its own scope since LT1 put the tests into the literal scan (config.literal_check_excludes).
